description: The requests of ./bench.sh smoke for a search role (a container with WEBAPP_ROLE=search). They go straight to the container through an SSH tunnel. No entry starts a search: a search that runs writes a history row to production, and a text without a stored reading can start a paid call. 'guards' says what each entry is for.

entries.guards: The readiness endpoint that the proxy asks every 2 seconds. A search role is ready once its search index has loaded.
The header search returns titles: it reads the search index and the people index in the role's memory, and sends no model call.

The search route answers in this role. One character of text is rejected after the in-flight limit and before the search starts (routes/api.combined-search.ts), so nothing is read, paid for, or written. The route answers only the site's own pages (server/site-origin.server.ts); Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin is what a page sends, and works for goodwatch.app and for a tunnel to one container alike, where an Origin would have to match the container's configured origin. A 403 here means that guard changed. A 503 with 'Search is busy' means that four searches were in flight, or that the process isn't a search role.
